name: group_mm
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_grouped_mm(Tensor self, Tensor mat2, Tensor? offs=None, Tensor? bias=None, ScalarType? out_dtype=None) -> Tensor. Catalog grouped_mm maps to canonical ATen _grouped_mm. The current FlagGems wrapper implements the grouped matrix multiply path with self, mat2, and offsets; tests cover deterministic jagged groups, output metadata, input non-mutation, invalid ranks/group counts, and grouped-GEMM TFLOPS metadata.
